extraction.Name: Ada McCloskey Whipple
extraction.Refused/Protested: No, I didn't say anything to anybody; it was just forced on me.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: I got a loan from Albert Nelson for $500.00, then I sold it to him because he said the taxes would be so high so I sold the land to him.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: he said the taxes would be so high so I sold the land to him
extraction.Occupation/Income: Working out, doing house work. My husband works at odd jobs.
extraction.NOTES: Patent delivered to allottee at her home by the government farmer; she did not go get it as she did not want it; husband handled the sale paperwork; allottee only signed papers and did not know the sale price; $500 loan used to buy milch cows and pigs; what little money she had left was used to buy a home in Parmelee; lived on allotment five years; two children, both married; superintendent named B. E.
